summary.privacy: In short: we collect only what is needed to run the marketplace. Your phone number is shared with the other person only after the farmer confirms an order.
summary.terms: In short: VivasayiMart connects farmers and buyers. Orders and payments are agreed directly between them.

p: When you use VivasayiMart we store:
list: Your name, email address and password (the password is stored in scrambled form; we cannot read it)
Your phone number, address or area, and farm details if you are a farmer
Photos and descriptions of products you list, and prices and stock
Your orders, reviews, saved items and reports you send
Technical information such as the type of phone or browser, used to fix problems

p: To run the marketplace: show listings, process order requests, send you emails (email verification and password reset), keep the site safe, and fix errors.

list: Public: a farmer's farm page (name, farm name, area, products, ratings and reviews).
Your phone number: shown only to you on your own listings. Between a buyer and a farmer it is shared only after the farmer confirms the order, and is hidden again if the order is cancelled.
Administrators can see reports and listings so they can keep the marketplace safe.

p: We use trusted services to run the site. They receive only what they need:
list: Google Gemini (product photos, product names and areas are sent to recognise the product and suggest a price)
data.gov.in (market prices; no personal data is sent)

p: We save your login, language choice and cart in your browser, and keep copies of some pages so the app works with a weak connection. These are cleared when you log out.

You can edit your profile and delete your listings at any time. To delete your account and personal data, open Account & privacy in the app or website and choose Delete my account. Open orders are cancelled; past orders stay as a basic record for the other person, with your name, phone number, address and notes removed.
Passwords are stored scrambled, logins expire after a few days, and connections are encrypted. No online service is perfectly secure, so please keep your password private.
If we change this policy we will update the date above. Using VivasayiMart after a change means you accept it.
VivasayiMart is a place where farmers list produce and buyers send order requests. We are not the seller, buyer or delivery service, and we do not handle payments.
Give correct information, keep your password private, and do not share your account. You are responsible for what happens under your account.

list: List only produce you can actually supply, with honest photos, prices and stock.
Keep stock and availability up to date.
Do not list illegal, unsafe or misleading items.
We may hide or remove listings that are reported or break these rules.

p: An order request is not final until the farmer confirms it. After confirmation, the buyer and farmer arrange pickup or delivery and the buyer pays the farmer directly (for example cash or UPI). Any disagreement about quality, quantity or payment is between the buyer and the farmer; we can help by hiding listings or accounts that misbehave, but we cannot refund payments.
Write honest reviews and be respectful. Do not harass others, post spam or try to misuse the service. You can report a listing from its card.
Product recognition and price suggestions are made by AI and can be wrong. Please check them before you publish a listing.
We try to keep VivasayiMart working, but it is provided as is, without guarantees. We are not responsible for the quality or safety of produce, for delivery, or for losses between buyers and farmers.
You can stop using VivasayiMart at any time. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.
We may update these terms and will change the date above. Using VivasayiMart after a change means you accept it.

account.title: Account & privacy
account.deleteWarn: This cannot be undone. When you delete your account:
deleteBullets: Your listings, profile, saved items and reports are deleted.
Orders that are still open are cancelled and the stock is returned.
Past orders stay as a record for the other person, but your name, phone number, address and notes are removed.
You will be logged out everywhere.
